comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reconciled 04296a7..97d8b07 against src/Keiki/Core.hs and codec changelogs, Hackage 0.9.1.0, and the upstream v0.9.1.0 tag. Correct: existing build-time-validation and overview now cover producer-owned exact Bool exhaustion of captured Eq/Ord closures in default inversion ambiguity analysis, unchanged integral proof, and conservative unsupported/opaque/negation boundaries. No new concept: this extends the existing inversion-proof contract. No catalog change: validation/replay API, forward determinism, and codec wire behavior are unchanged; exhaustive proof tests and OKF review bootstrap add evidence only.

Reconciled 4a4f8a91..de574cdc against released 0.15.0.0 source and all seven matching upstream package tags; Hackage preferred versions confirmed on 2026-09-06. Correct: concise package record-dot APIs and preserved abstract checked/prepared boundaries, idiomatic-v2 build defaults, every pre-v2 ledger gate, combined legacy migration and recovery, terminal outbox rejection and conditional atomic batch finalization, migration 0031, console/telemetry, and Store 0.8 transient worker classification. Existing Language 5 semantics, canonical/JSON/wire keys, fingerprints, and runtime replay are preserved by the presentation migration. Watch now includes framework migrations and the published test-support package.

Watch now includes the actual migration package, adapter, and CLI rather than the nonexistent root migrations path.
